# Overview

This project uses R to analyze five synthetic student grades. The goal is to calculate the average grade and explain the results using R Markdown.

# Project Objectives

- Store five synthetic student grades.
- Calculate the average grade using R.
- Display and explain the result.
- Demonstrate clear documentation using R Markdown.

# R Code

```{r student-grades}
grades <- c(75, 80, 85, 90, 95)
average_grade <- mean(grades)
print(average_grade)
```

# Expected Results

The five grades are 75, 80, 85, 90, and 95. Their calculated average is 85.

# Conclusion

This example demonstrates how R can be used to organize numerical data and calculate a simple summary statistic. The student grades are synthetic and do not represent real students.
